regions.label: body
regions.text:
بورڈ نے اپنے اجلاس منعقدہ 04 مارچ 2017ء میں میٹرک اور انٹرسلطح پر تعلیمی سیشن 17-2015 اور مابعد کیلئے عملی امتحان کے سابقہ طریقہ کار بابت سکیم آف سٹڈیز 2013 کی بحالی کے معاملہ میں PBCC کے اجلاس منعقدہ 24 دسمبر 2016 میں منظور شدہ SOPS پر شعبہ امتحانات کی طرف سے دی گئی Observations سے اتفاق کرتے ہوئے بذریعہ SOPS کی منظوری دی ہے۔
1- The division of marks in each subject in SSC/I ISSC in theory objective/subjective portion and as well as the practical will be as per Annual Examination, 2013 as directed and desired by the worthy Chief Minister.
The practical in each subject will be conducted separately after completion of class 10th &
2- 12th Examinations. The marks of practical would be counted with theory marks obtained by the candidates.
3- The practical labs would be constituted by the Board either in the Government or private institutions affiliated with the Board.
1- The practical in each subject will be conducted in other institutions where the availability is possible.
5- The Board will issue computerized practical schedule of the relevant practical i.e. date time and lab on the roll number slips of the candidates.
6- The Board will provide practical cut list of the candidates batch wise/subject wise according to practical centre/labs.
7- The Board will appoint the well reputed and honest practical Examiners for the conduct of practical examination.
8- The candidate who fails either in theory/practical paper or in both, he/she will be declared as fail and will reappear in theory paper and practical in next available chances, if eligible.
9- If a candidate passes in theory paper but fails in practical in any subject, then he/she will be declared fail in the same subject of part-II and will reappear in theory part-II and practical in next available chances if eligible.
10- The Examiners appointed by the Board would be bound to perform the practical duty because examination duty has been declared mandatory by the Government of the Punjab.
11- The Scheme of Studies is effective for the session 2015-17 and onward.
12- Appointment of competent, efficient and honest staff for the duty of practical examinations will be ensured and this duty should be mandatory without any excuse.
13- Model papers for the practical exams have been prepared by the subject specialists and be ensured that they are available on the official wibsites of all BI&SEs in Punjab.
